company.shortDescription: Habana Labs is a semiconductor company focusing on developing disruptive solutions for data center and cloud efficiency.
company.description:
Habana Labs is a semiconductor company focusing on developing disruptive solutions for data center and cloud efficiency. It was founded in 2016 to unlock the true potential of AI by providing an order of magnitude improvements in processing performance, cost, and power consumption. The company set out to develop AI processors from the ground up, optimized for the specific needs of training deep neural networks and for inference deployment in production environments.

Habana Labs is headquartered in San Jose, California, with media centers in Tel-Aviv, Israel, Gdansk, Poland, and Beijing, China.

aiResearchSummary.text: Habana Labs is engaged in developing methods for compressing neural networks through unbiased minimum variance pruning, as described in 'Compressing neural networks through unbiased minimum variance pruning,' which details techniques for pruning tensors in deep learning operations. Additionally, research includes cache memory with decoupled control paths and systems enabling rendezvous flow with RDMA write exchange, highlighting focus areas in neural network optimization, memory architecture, and data transfer efficiency.
